en.joke: My phone's weekly report said I spent 7 hours a day on it. I replied, 'Someone had to keep you company.'
en.explanation: It's funny because it personifies the phone, using dry irony to justify excessive screen time and highlight modern dependency.

people.name: Jean Barker, Baroness Trumpington
people.extract: Jean Alys Barker, Baroness Trumpington, was a British Conservative politician and life peer. In the 1960s and 1970s she served in local government in Cambridgeshire. In 1980 she was created a life peer after which she served in the House of Lords. From an upper-class background, she was a socialite and a secretary before entering politics, as well as serving in naval intelligence in World War II.
highlights: British Conservative politician and life peer.
Served in local government in Cambridgeshire.
Served in naval intelligence in World War II.

people.name: Jasmin St. Claire
people.bio: American pornographic film actress and professional wrestling personality
people.extract: Jasmin St. Claire is an American former pornographic film actress. She is also known for her work as a professional wrestling personality, most notably for Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). She has made appearances in the world of professional wrestling and such films as Communication Breakdown and National Lampoon's Dorm Daze 2.
highlights: Appeared in films like Communication Breakdown.

people.name: Maximilian Ulysses Browne
people.extract: Maximilian Ulysses, Reichsgraf von Browne, Baron de Camus and Mountany was an Austrian military officer, one of the highest-ranking officers serving the Habsburg Emperor during the middle of the 18th century. An Irish refugee, he was a scion of the Wild Geese.
highlights: Highest-ranking officer for the Habsburg Emperor.
An Irish refugee, scion of the Wild Geese.
